verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents its own automations that run in response to webhook events and integrate with Slack, GitHub and Linear. It also describes concrete event-triggered templates, such as acting once per configurable PR label event and replying to Slack @mentions, with Agent Canvas serving as a control center for automations. However, how users define their own trigger rules is shown only through vendor templates and marketing copy, not in-depth configuration docs. missing for 10: documentation of user-defined rule/condition syntax and event filters beyond prebuilt templates, independent or hands-on corroboration of event-triggered automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Create automations and workflows that integrate with Slack, GitHub, Linear, and more. Run on a schedule or in response to webhook events
Watch for a configurable label on pull requests, inspect full PR context, and post an AI review comment once per label event.
Watch Slack channels for @openhands mentions, open a conversation with the message context, and reply when the agent finishes.
Agent Canvas is the open-source browser client and control center for agent conversations and automations.
